author: Anthropic (official Project Glasswing announcement)
text: We plan to launch new safeguards with an upcoming Claude Opus model, allowing us to improve and refine them with a model that does not pose the same level of risk as Mythos Preview
notes: Opus 4.7 launched 9 days later (2026-04-16) and its post says it is the first such model with the new cyber safeguards.

author: Anthropic (official Project Glasswing announcement)
text: We do not plan to make Claude Mythos Preview generally available, but our eventual goal is to enable our users to safely deploy Mythos-class models at scale
notes: No date given. Fable 5 (a Mythos-class model for general use) shipped 2026-06-09.

author: Anthropic (official Claude Opus 4.7 launch post)
text: What we learn from the real-world deployment of these safeguards will help us work towards our eventual goal of a broad release of Mythos-class models.

author: Anthropic (official post "Expanding Project Glasswing")
text: We’re working as quickly as we can to safely release Mythos-level capabilities in general access.
notes: No date given; Fable 5 shipped 7 days later.

author: Anthropic (official post "Redeploying Fable 5")
text: Fable 5 will be available starting tomorrow, Wednesday, July 1, to users globally on the Claude Platform, Claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork.
notes: Re-availability date after the 2026-06-12 suspension; fulfilled (API and app release notes record access restored 2026-07-01). Same post said AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry access would be re-enabled "as quickly as possible" (no date).
